units.source_text: 一听说有泉水，我就跑步奔去。

en.t: As soon as I heard there was a spring, I ran over to it.

units.source_text: 清澈的泉水，从林荫掩盖下的岩石缝隙里喷涌而出。

en.t: Clear spring water gushed out from a crack in the rock hidden under the shade of the trees.

units.source_text: 姑娘们都站立在泉水的周围。

en.t: The girls were all standing around the spring.
